  1. HYDROGEN THERMODYNAMICS & LOW-MOLECULAR-WEIGHT AERODYNAMICS:
     - Pure gaseous hydrogen (H2, 99.999% purity) possesses a standard molecular weight MW = 2.01588 g/mol.
       Compared to natural gas (methane, MW approx 16.04 g/mol) and ambient air (MW approx 28.97 g/mol), hydrogen
       is extraordinarily light. The individual specific gas constant R_spec = R_u / MW is:
          R_spec = 8314.462 J/(kmol*K) / 2.01588 kg/kmol = 4124.48 J/(kg*K).
     - Because sonic velocity is governed by a = sqrt(gamma * Z * R_spec * T), where gamma approx 1.405 and the
       compressibility factor Z > 1.0 at 100 bar, the acoustic speed in pure hydrogen exceeds 1,320 m/s at 300 K
       (and over 1,400 m/s under compressor discharge conditions at 350 K).
     - As a consequence of this ultra-high acoustic velocity, the peripheral tip Mach number:
          M_u = u_tip / a

       450 to 520 m/s. The flow remains deep in the subsonic regime throughout all impeller cascades.
     - The aerodynamic consequence is severe: Euler's turbomachine equation dictates that the isentropic or
       polytropic head rise per stage delta_h_p = mu * u_tip^2 yields very modest pressure ratios (typically
       1.10 to 1.18 per stage) because of hydrogen's massive heat capacity (c_p approx 14.3 kJ/(kg*K)).
       Achieving a compression ratio of 2.0 (e.g. 50 bar suction to 100 bar pipeline discharge) requires
       either an ultra-high shaft speed (18,500 - 24,000 RPM) multi-stage barrel casing (API 617 Type BCD)
       with 6 to 8 impellers, or multi-body geared arrangements.
     - Equation of State (EOS) at 100 bar: Hydrogen deviates significantly from ideal gas behavior.
       Unlike hydrocarbons which exhibit Z < 1.0 at moderate pressures due to attractive van der Waals forces,
       hydrogen molecules at ambient temperatures exhibit repulsive intermolecular forces, yielding Z > 1.0
       (Z approx 1.055 to 1.065 at 100 bar).
       Furthermore, the Joule-Thomson inversion temperature of pure hydrogen is approximately 202 K (-71 deg C).
       At pipeline ambient and operating temperatures (280 K to 360 K), the Joule-Thomson coefficient mu_JT is
       NEGATIVE (mu_JT < 0). Therefore, throttling or depressurizing high-pressure hydrogen across a valve
       causes heating rather than cooling! This thermal phenomenon poses critical safety risks to valve seats
       and downstream pipe metallurgical integrity.

  2. DYNAMIC SURGE INSTABILITY & LOW-MACH ANTI-SURGE RECYCLE MODULATION:
     - The steep head-capacity characteristic of low-Mach hydrogen impellers compresses the operating envelope
       between the choke limit and the surge limit line (SLL).
     - Acoustic wave transit times across the pipeline header and recycle piping are extremely short because
       of the 1,320+ m/s sound speed. Consequently, the characteristic Helmholtz resonance frequency of the
       compression system:
          omega_H = a * sqrt( A_c / (V_p * L_c) )

       vent cavity. Under 100 bar differential, normal primary leakage is 3.0 to 8.0 Nm3/h per seal cartridge.

     - Secondary seal stage is buffered with pure Nitrogen (N2) at 1.5 to 2.5 bar gauge, preventing any H2
       from migrating into atmospheric bearing cavities. Continuous thermal conductivity / catalytic Lower
       Explosive Limit (% LEL) sensors monitor vent streams with automatic SIL-3 ESD trip at 50% LEL.

  4. PIPELINE ACOUSTIC WAVE STANDING WAVE PULSATION DAMPING:
     - Centrifugal turbocompressor blade-pass frequencies and aerodynamic diffuser stall cells excite acoustic
       cavity resonance modes in the 100 bar discharge manifold.

    (* Mid-Value Median Filter *)

       (arrSuctPress_Raw[1] >= arrSuctPress_Raw[3] AND arrSuctPress_Raw[1] <= arrSuctPress_Raw[2]) THEN

(* 2.4 TEMPERATURE & SHAFT SPEED 2oo3 VOTING *)
(* Suction Temperature Median Selection *)
IF (arrSuctTemp_Raw[1] >= arrSuctTemp_Raw[2] AND arrSuctTemp_Raw[1] <= arrSuctTemp_Raw[3]) OR

(* === 3. HIGH-PRESSURE HYDROGEN REAL-TIME THERMODYNAMICS & EQUATION OF STATE === *)
(* 3.1 Gas Composition & Molecular Weight Supervision *)
IF rGasMolecularWeight_gmol >= 1.80 AND rGasMolecularWeight_gmol <= 5.00 THEN
    rGasConstant_Rspec := c_rUniversalGasConstant / (rGasMolecularWeight_gmol * 0.001);
ELSE
    rGasConstant_Rspec := c_rUniversalGasConstant / (c_rNominalMolecularWeight_H2 * 0.001);
END_IF;

IF rGasSpecificHeatRatio >= 1.30 AND rGasSpecificHeatRatio <= 1.50 THEN
    rGamma := rGasSpecificHeatRatio;
ELSE
    rGamma := 1.405; (* Standard diatomic hydrogen specific heat ratio *)
END_IF;

(* 3.2 High-Pressure Compressibility Factor Z(P, T) via Virial EOS for Hydrogen *)
(* Z = 1 + [ b0 + b1*(300/T) ] * P_bar *)
rZ_Suct  := 1.0 + (0.00055 + 0.00015 * (300.0 / rSuctTemp_Voted_K)) * rSuctPress_Voted_bar;
rZ_Disch := 1.0 + (0.00055 + 0.00015 * (300.0 / rDischTemp_Voted_K)) * rDischPress_Voted_bar;
rZ_Avg   := (rZ_Suct + rZ_Disch) * 0.5;

(* 3.3 Suction Gas Density & Sonic Velocity *)
(* rho = (P * 10^5) / (Z * R_spec * T) [kg/m3] *)
rGasDensitySuction_kgm3 := (rSuctPress_Voted_bar * 100000.0) / (rZ_Suct * rGasConstant_Rspec * rSuctTemp_Voted_K);
rGasDensitySuction_kgm3 := MAX(0.5, MIN(25.0, rGasDensitySuction_kgm3));

(* Speed of sound: a = sqrt(gamma * Z * R_spec * T) [m/s] *)
rSpeedOfSound_ms := SQRT(rGamma * rZ_Avg * rGasConstant_Rspec * rSuctTemp_Voted_K);
rSpeedOfSound_ms := MAX(1000.0, MIN(1600.0, rSpeedOfSound_ms));

(* 3.4 Compression Ratio & Polytropic Head *)
IF rSuctPress_Voted_bar > 1.0 THEN
    rCompressionRatio := rDischPress_Voted_bar / rSuctPress_Voted_bar;
ELSE
    rCompressionRatio := 1.0;
END_IF;

(* Polytropic Exponent n and factor m = (n-1)/n, assuming stage polytropic efficiency approx 0.825 *)
rPolytropicFactor_m := (rGamma - 1.0) / (rGamma * 0.825);
rPolytropicExponent_n := 1.0 / (1.0 - rPolytropicFactor_m);

(* Polytropic Head: H_p = [ Z_avg * R_spec * T_suct / m ] * [ (Rc)^m - 1.0 ] [kJ/kg] *)
IF rCompressionRatio > 1.001 THEN
    rPolytropicHead_kJkg := (rZ_Avg * rGasConstant_Rspec * rSuctTemp_Voted_K / rPolytropicFactor_m) *
                            (EXPT(rCompressionRatio, rPolytropicFactor_m) - 1.0) * 0.001;
ELSE
    rPolytropicHead_kJkg := 0.0;
END_IF;
rPolytropicHead_kJkg := MAX(0.0, MIN(350.0, rPolytropicHead_kJkg));

(* 3.5 Mass Flow Rate & Reduced Flow Coordinates *)
(* Flow from differential pressure orifice: m_dot = C_d * eps * (pi/4)*d^2 * sqrt(2 * rho * DeltaP) *)
IF rFlowDP_Voted_mbar > 0.0 THEN
    rMassFlow_kgs := 0.0482 * SQRT(2.0 * rGasDensitySuction_kgm3 * (rFlowDP_Voted_mbar * 100.0));
ELSE
    rMassFlow_kgs := 0.0;
END_IF;
rActualVolumetricFlow_m3s := rMassFlow_kgs / rGasDensitySuction_kgm3;

(* Reduced Flow Squared: q_red^2 = (m_dot^2 * Z_suct * T_suct / MW) / P_suct^2 *)
IF rSuctPress_Voted_bar > 1.0 THEN
    rReducedFlow_Squared := (rMassFlow_kgs * rMassFlow_kgs * rZ_Suct * rSuctTemp_Voted_K /
                            (c_rNominalMolecularWeight_H2 * 0.001)) /
                            (rSuctPress_Voted_bar * rSuctPress_Voted_bar * 100.0);
ELSE
    rReducedFlow_Squared := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* === 4. DYNAMIC ANTI-SURGE LIMIT LINES & SURGE MARGIN METRICS === *)
(* 4.1 Parabolic Surge Limit Line (SLL) in Head vs Reduced Flow Squared *)
(* FlowSquared_SLL = (PolytropicHead - K0) / K2 *)
IF rPolytropicHead_kJkg >= c_rSLL_K0 THEN
    rFlowSquared_SLL := 0.50;
ELSE
    rFlowSquared_SLL := (rPolytropicHead_kJkg - c_rSLL_K0) / c_rSLL_K2;
END_IF;
rFlowSquared_SLL := MAX(0.50, MIN(120.0, rFlowSquared_SLL));

(* 4.2 Dynamic Biases to Safety Margin *)
(* Molecular Weight Bias: If gas is heavier than pure H2 due to contaminant ingress, shift SLL outward *)
IF rGasMolecularWeight_gmol > c_rNominalMolecularWeight_H2 THEN
    rMolecularWeightShiftBias_pct := (rGasMolecularWeight_gmol - c_rNominalMolecularWeight_H2) * 8.5;
ELSE
    rMolecularWeightShiftBias_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Acceleration Bias: When machine accelerates rapidly, add transient safety margin *)
IF (rShaftSpeed_Voted_rpm - rPrevShaftSpeed_rpm) > 5.0 THEN
    rAccelerationBias_pct := ((rShaftSpeed_Voted_rpm - rPrevShaftSpeed_rpm) / rDt) * 0.004;
ELSE
    rAccelerationBias_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;
rAccelerationBias_pct := MIN(6.0, rAccelerationBias_pct);

(* Acoustic Pulsation Bias: High standing waves in discharge line reduce aerodynamic boundary layer stability *)
IF rAcousticPulsationRMS_mbar > 1200.0 THEN
    rAcousticPulsationBias_pct := (rAcousticPulsationRMS_mbar - 1200.0) * 0.0025;
ELSE
    rAcousticPulsationBias_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;
rAcousticPulsationBias_pct := MIN(5.0, rAcousticPulsationBias_pct);

(* Total Dynamic Surge Control Margin *)
rDynamicSafetyMargin_pct := c_rBaseSurgeMargin_pct + rMolecularWeightShiftBias_pct +
                            rAccelerationBias_pct + rAcousticPulsationBias_pct;
rDynamicSafetyMargin_pct := MAX(10.0, MIN(28.0, rDynamicSafetyMargin_pct));

(* 4.3 Control Boundaries Coordinates *)
(* Surge Control Line (SCL) *)
rFlowSquared_SCL := rFlowSquared_SLL * (1.0 + rDynamicSafetyMargin_pct * 0.01) * (1.0 + rDynamicSafetyMargin_pct * 0.01);

(* Surge Backup Line (SBL) *)
rFlowSquared_SBL := rFlowSquared_SLL * (1.0 + c_rBackupSurgeMargin_pct * 0.01) * (1.0 + c_rBackupSurgeMargin_pct * 0.01);

(* Solenoid Trip Kick Line (SKL) *)
rFlowSquared_SKL := rFlowSquared_SLL * (1.0 + c_rSolenoidTripMargin_pct * 0.01) * (1.0 + c_rSolenoidTripMargin_pct * 0.01);

(* 4.4 Normalized Surge Margin & Rate of Approach *)
IF rFlowSquared_SLL > 0.01 THEN
    rSurgeMargin_pct := ((rReducedFlow_Squared - rFlowSquared_SLL) / rFlowSquared_SLL) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rSurgeMargin_pct := 50.0;
END_IF;

IF rFlowSquared_SCL > 0.01 THEN
    rDistanceToSCL_pct := ((rReducedFlow_Squared - rFlowSquared_SCL) / rFlowSquared_SCL) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rDistanceToSCL_pct := 25.0;
END_IF;

(* Numerical derivative of surge margin dSigma/dt [%/s] *)
rRateOfApproachToSurge_pct_s := (rSurgeMargin_pct - rPrevSurgeMargin_pct) / rDt;

(* Open-Loop Derivative Surge Kick Logic *)
IF bFastValveKickEnable AND (rRateOfApproachToSurge_pct_s < -15.0) AND (rDistanceToSCL_pct < 8.0) THEN
    bFastValveKickActive := TRUE;
    (* Calculate instantaneous valve kick magnitude proportional to approach velocity *)
    rRateOfApproachBias_pct := ABS(rRateOfApproachToSurge_pct_s + 15.0) * 1.25;
    rRateOfApproachBias_pct := MIN(50.0, rRateOfApproachBias_pct);
    IF rRateOfApproachBias_pct > rValveKickBias_pct THEN
        rValveKickBias_pct := rRateOfApproachBias_pct;
    END_IF;
    dwWarningWord1 := dwWarningWord1 OR 16#00000008; (* Bit 3: Fast Valve Kick Active *)
ELSE
    bFastValveKickActive := FALSE;
    (* Smooth exponential decay of open-loop kick bias *)
    rValveKickBias_pct := rValveKickBias_pct * rValveKickDecay;
    IF rValveKickBias_pct < 0.20 THEN
        rValveKickBias_pct := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* === 5. DISCRETE 5x5 STATE-SPACE DYNAMIC MODEL SIMULATION === *)
(* State Vector:
   x[1]: Delta_Flow (kg/s)
   x[2]: Delta_P_disch (bar)
   x[3]: Delta_P_suct (bar)
   x[4]: Delta_Speed (rpm)
   x[5]: Delta_P_acoustic (mbar)
*)
(* Populate Discretized Dynamic Matrix A_d (5x5) *)
arrMatA[1,1] := 0.8850; arrMatA[1,2] := -0.0450; arrMatA[1,3] := 0.0650; arrMatA[1,4] := 0.0012; arrMatA[1,5] := -0.0008;
arrMatA[2,1] := 0.0350; arrMatA[2,2] := 0.9420;  arrMatA[2,3] := 0.0150; arrMatA[2,4] := 0.0022; arrMatA[2,5] := 0.0011;
arrMatA[3,1] := -0.0280;arrMatA[3,2] := 0.0080;  arrMatA[3,3] := 0.9510; arrMatA[3,4] := -0.0004;arrMatA[3,5] := 0.0002;
arrMatA[4,1] := -0.0150;arrMatA[4,2] := -0.0080; arrMatA[4,3] := 0.0050; arrMatA[4,4] := 0.9850; arrMatA[4,5] := 0.0000;
arrMatA[5,1] := 0.0520; arrMatA[5,2] := 0.0780;  arrMatA[5,3] := -0.0210;arrMatA[5,4] := 0.0014; arrMatA[5,5] := 0.7200;

(* Populate Input Coupling Matrix B_d (5x3)
   u[1]: Delta_ASV_Position_pct
   u[2]: Delta_Speed_Ref_rpm
   u[3]: Delta_Vac_Valve_pct
*)
arrMatB[1,1] := 0.3200; arrMatB[1,2] := -0.0002; arrMatB[1,3] := 0.0000;
arrMatB[2,1] := -0.2800;arrMatB[2,2] := 0.0042;  arrMatB[2,3] := 0.0000;
arrMatB[3,1] := 0.1900; arrMatB[3,2] := -0.0008; arrMatB[3,3] := 0.0000;
arrMatB[4,1] := 0.0250; arrMatB[4,2] := 0.0850;  arrMatB[4,3] := 0.0000;
arrMatB[5,1] := -0.1500;arrMatB[5,2] := 0.0005;  arrMatB[5,3] := 0.0000;

(* Populate Output Observation Matrix C_d (4x5)
   y[1]: Surge Margin Deviation (%)
   y[2]: Compression Ratio Deviation (-)
   y[3]: Seal Differential Pressure Deviation (bar)
   y[4]: Acoustic Dynamic Pressure RMS (mbar)
*)
arrMatC[1,1] := 1.450; arrMatC[1,2] := -0.320; arrMatC[1,3] := 0.280; arrMatC[1,4] := 0.015; arrMatC[1,5] := -0.050;
arrMatC[2,1] := -0.012;arrMatC[2,2] := 0.020;  arrMatC[2,3] := -0.020;arrMatC[2,4] := 0.0001;arrMatC[2,5] := 0.0000;
arrMatC[3,1] := 0.000; arrMatC[3,2] := 0.000;  arrMatC[3,3] := -0.010;arrMatC[3,4] := 0.0000;arrMatC[3,5] := 0.0000;
arrMatC[4,1] := 0.000; arrMatC[4,2] := 0.000;  arrMatC[4,3] := 0.000; arrMatC[4,4] := 0.0000;arrMatC[4,5] := 1.0000;

(* Populate Feedthrough Matrix D_d (4x3) *)
arrMatD[1,1] := 0.420; arrMatD[1,2] := 0.000; arrMatD[1,3] := 0.000;
arrMatD[2,1] := -0.005;arrMatD[2,2] := 0.0001;arrMatD[2,3] := 0.000;
arrMatD[3,1] := 0.000; arrMatD[3,2] := 0.000; arrMatD[3,3] := 0.000;
arrMatD[4,1] := -0.120;arrMatD[4,2] := 0.000; arrMatD[4,3] := 0.000;

(* Plant Observation Feedback into State Vector *)
arrStateX[1] := rMassFlow_kgs - 3.25;
arrStateX[2] := rDischPress_Voted_bar - 100.0;
arrStateX[3] := rSuctPress_Voted_bar - 50.0;
arrStateX[4] := rShaftSpeed_Voted_rpm - 18500.0;
arrStateX[5] := rAcousticDynamicPress_CH2_bar * 1000.0;

(* Input Vector *)
arrInputU[1] := rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct - 20.0;
arrInputU[2] := rSpeedRefActual_rpm - 18500.0;
arrInputU[3] := rVacValveActual_pct - 35.0;

(* Compute x[k+1] = A_d * x[k] + B_d * u[k] *)
FOR iState := 1 TO 5 DO
    arrNextStateX[iState] := arrMatA[iState,1] * arrStateX[1] +
                             arrMatA[iState,2] * arrStateX[2] +
                             arrMatA[iState,3] * arrStateX[3] +
                             arrMatA[iState,4] * arrStateX[4] +
                             arrMatA[iState,5] * arrStateX[5] +
                             arrMatB[iState,1] * arrInputU[1] +
                             arrMatB[iState,2] * arrInputU[2] +
                             arrMatB[iState,3] * arrInputU[3];
END_FOR;

(* Compute y[k] = C_d * x[k] + D_d * u[k] *)
FOR iState := 1 TO 4 DO
    arrOutputY[iState] := arrMatC[iState,1] * arrStateX[1] +
                          arrMatC[iState,2] * arrStateX[2] +
                          arrMatC[iState,3] * arrStateX[3] +
                          arrMatC[iState,4] * arrStateX[4] +
                          arrMatC[iState,5] * arrStateX[5] +
                          arrMatD[iState,1] * arrInputU[1] +
                          arrMatD[iState,2] * arrInputU[2] +
                          arrMatD[iState,3] * arrInputU[3];
END_FOR;

(* === 6. MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) QUADRATIC COST OPTIMIZATION === *)
IF bMPCControlEnable AND NOT bCompressorTrip THEN
    (* Evaluate Gradient: g = H * Delta_u + F * x0 *)
    (* Target: maintain surge margin at setpoint (arrOutputSP[1] = 15%), minimize acoustic energy *)
    arrGradientG[1] := arrWeightQ[1] * (arrOutputY[1] - arrOutputSP[1]) * arrMatD[1,1] +
                       arrWeightQ[4] * (arrOutputY[4] - arrOutputSP[4]) * arrMatD[4,1] +
                       arrWeightR[1] * arrDeltaU_Opt[1];

    arrGradientG[2] := arrWeightQ[2] * (arrOutputY[2] - arrOutputSP[2]) * arrMatD[2,2] +
                       arrWeightR[2] * arrDeltaU_Opt[2];

    arrGradientG[3] := arrWeightQ[3] * (arrOutputY[3] - arrOutputSP[3]) * 0.10 +
                       arrWeightR[3] * arrDeltaU_Opt[3];

    (* Numerical conditioning check *)
    IF ABS(arrGradientG[1]) > 5000.0 OR ABS(arrGradientG[2]) > 5000.0 THEN
        bMpcIllConditioned := TRUE;
        dwWarningWord2 := dwWarningWord2 OR 16#00000080; (* Bit 7: MPC Ill-conditioned *)
    ELSE
        bMpcIllConditioned := FALSE;
    END_IF;

    IF NOT bMpcIllConditioned THEN
        (* Projected gradient descent move *)
        arrDeltaU_Opt[1] := -rMpcStepAlpha * arrGradientG[1];
        arrDeltaU_Opt[2] := -rMpcStepAlpha * arrGradientG[2];
        arrDeltaU_Opt[3] := -rMpcStepAlpha * arrGradientG[3];

        (* Clamp optimal control rate to asymmetric actuator limits *)
        arrDeltaU_Opt[1] := MAX(-c_rASV_MaxCloseRate_pct_s * rDt,
                            MIN(c_rASV_MaxOpenRate_pct_s * rDt, arrDeltaU_Opt[1]));

        (* If distance to SCL is negative (inside control margin), prioritize fast opening *)
        IF rDistanceToSCL_pct < 0.0 THEN
            arrDeltaU_Opt[1] := arrDeltaU_Opt[1] + ABS(rDistanceToSCL_pct) * 0.45;
        END_IF;

        bMPCActive := TRUE;
    ELSE
        bMPCActive := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bMPCActive := FALSE;
    arrDeltaU_Opt[1] := 0.0;
    arrDeltaU_Opt[2] := 0.0;
    arrDeltaU_Opt[3] := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* 6.1 Decoupled PID Anti-Surge Fallback (Active if MPC is inactive or ill-conditioned) *)
IF NOT bMPCActive AND NOT bCompressorTrip THEN
    (* Error defined as distance to Surge Control Line: e = SCL - Operating_Point *)
    rASV_PID_Derivative := ((rFlowSquared_SCL - rReducedFlow_Squared) - rASV_PID_PrevError) / rDt;
    rASV_PID_PrevError  := (rFlowSquared_SCL - rReducedFlow_Squared);

    IF rDistanceToSCL_pct < 0.0 THEN
        (* Operating point is inside SCL: aggressive opening proportional action *)
        rASV_PID_Integral := rASV_PID_Integral + 2.5 * ABS(rDistanceToSCL_pct) * rDt;
        rASV_PID_Output := 15.0 + 3.2 * ABS(rDistanceToSCL_pct) + rASV_PID_Integral + 0.15 * rASV_PID_Derivative;
    ELSE
        (* Safe operating region: slowly ramp integral closed *)
        rASV_PID_Integral := rASV_PID_Integral - 0.45 * rDt;
        rASV_PID_Output := rASV_PID_Integral;
    END_IF;
    rASV_PID_Integral := MAX(0.0, MIN(100.0, rASV_PID_Integral));
    rASV_PID_Output   := MAX(0.0, MIN(100.0, rASV_PID_Output));
END_IF;

(* === 7. PIPELINE ACOUSTIC WAVE STANDING WAVE PULSATION ACTIVE DAMPING === *)
(* 7.1 Dynamic Pressure Input from Piezo Transducer [bar -> mbar] *)
rAcousticInput_mbar := rAcousticDynamicPress_CH2_bar * 1000.0;

(* 7.2 2nd-Order Butterworth Digital Bandpass Filter (120 - 350 Hz) *)
(* Difference equation: Y0 = b0*X0 + b1*X1 + b2*X2 - a1*Y1 - a2*Y2 *)
rAcousticFilt_X0 := rAcousticInput_mbar;
rAcousticFilt_Y0 := c_rIIR_b0 * rAcousticFilt_X0 +
                    c_rIIR_b1 * rAcousticFilt_X1 +
                    c_rIIR_b2 * rAcousticFilt_X2 -
                    c_rIIR_a1 * rAcousticFilt_Y1 -
                    c_rIIR_a2 * rAcousticFilt_Y2;

(* Update delay registers *)
rAcousticFilt_X2 := rAcousticFilt_X1;
rAcousticFilt_X1 := rAcousticFilt_X0;
rAcousticFilt_Y2 := rAcousticFilt_Y1;
rAcousticFilt_Y1 := rAcousticFilt_Y0;

(* 7.3 Rolling Window RMS Calculation (100 samples) *)
rAcousticSumSquares := rAcousticSumSquares -
                       (arrAcousticHistory[iAcousticHistIndex] * arrAcousticHistory[iAcousticHistIndex]);
arrAcousticHistory[iAcousticHistIndex] := rAcousticFilt_Y0;
rAcousticSumSquares := rAcousticSumSquares + (rAcousticFilt_Y0 * rAcousticFilt_Y0);
iAcousticHistIndex := iAcousticHistIndex + 1;
IF iAcousticHistIndex > 100 THEN
    iAcousticHistIndex := 1;
END_IF;
IF rAcousticSumSquares > 0.0 THEN
    rAcousticPulsationRMS_mbar := SQRT(rAcousticSumSquares * 0.01);
ELSE
    rAcousticPulsationRMS_mbar := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* 7.4 Phase-Lead Dynamic Anti-Pulsation Modulation *)
IF bAcousticDampingEnable AND (rAcousticPulsationRMS_mbar > 450.0) AND NOT bCompressorTrip THEN
    (* Phase lead transfer function: G_lead = K * (Y0 + tau * dY/dt) *)
    rAcousticPhaseLeadOutput := -c_rAcousticPhaseLeadGain *
                                (rAcousticFilt_Y0 + 0.0022 * ((rAcousticFilt_Y0 - rAcousticFilt_Y1) / rDt));

    (* Micro-dither command clamped between -c_rAcousticDitherMaxClamp_pct and +c_rAcousticDitherMaxClamp_pct *)
    rAcousticDitherModulation := MAX(-c_rAcousticDitherMaxClamp_pct,
                                 MIN(c_rAcousticDitherMaxClamp_pct, rAcousticPhaseLeadOutput));
    bAcousticDampingEngaged := TRUE;
ELSE
    rAcousticDitherModulation := 0.0;
    bAcousticDampingEngaged := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* === 8. DRY GAS SEAL LEAKAGE VACUUM EXTRACTION SUBSYSTEM === *)
(* 8.1 Primary Seal Gas Differential Pressure Supervision *)
rPrimarySealDP_bar := rSealGasSupplyPress_bar - rSuctPress_Voted_bar;

IF rPrimarySealDP_bar < c_rCriticalLowSealDP_bar THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00000200; (* Bit 9: Primary Seal Gas DP Low-Low *)
ELSIF rPrimarySealDP_bar < c_rMinPrimarySealDP_bar THEN
    dwWarningWord1 := dwWarningWord1 OR 16#00000400; (* Bit 10: Seal DP Low Warning *)
END_IF;

(* 8.2 Primary Vent Cavity Pressure Regulation (-80.0 mbar gauge setpoint) *)
rVac_PID_Error := rPrimaryVentPress_mbar - c_rVacSetpoint_mbar;

(* Anti-windup PID formulation for vacuum extraction modulating valve *)
rVac_PID_Derivative := (rVac_PID_Error - rVac_PID_PrevError) / rDt;
rVac_PID_PrevError  := rVac_PID_Error;

rVac_PID_Integral := rVac_PID_Integral + (0.015 * rVac_PID_Error * rDt);
rVac_PID_Integral := MAX(0.0, MIN(100.0, rVac_PID_Integral));

rVacExtractionValveRaw_pct := 35.0 + (0.28 * rVac_PID_Error) + rVac_PID_Integral + (0.05 * rVac_PID_Derivative);
rVacExtractionValveRaw_pct := MAX(0.0, MIN(100.0, rVacExtractionValveRaw_pct));

IF rPrimaryVentPress_mbar >= -120.0 AND rPrimaryVentPress_mbar <= 200.0 THEN
    bSealVacuumHealthy := TRUE;
ELSE
    bSealVacuumHealthy := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* 8.3 Secondary Buffer Nitrogen Gas & LEL Protection *)
IF rBufferN2SupplyPress_bar < 1.50 THEN
    dwAlarmWord3 := dwAlarmWord3 OR 16#00000001; (* Bit 0: N2 Buffer Supply Low-Low *)
END_IF;

IF rSealVentH2Concentration_LEL >= c_rTripH2Concentration_LEL THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00001000; (* Bit 12: Vent Duct H2 LEL High-High Trip *)
ELSIF rSealVentH2Concentration_LEL >= 25.0 THEN
    dwWarningWord2 := dwWarningWord2 OR 16#00000800; (* Bit 11: Vent Duct H2 LEL High Warning *)
END_IF;

IF rPrimarySealLeakage_Nm3h >= c_rTripPrimaryLeakage_Nm3h THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00000800; (* Bit 11: Primary Seal Leakage High-High Trip *)
ELSIF rPrimarySealLeakage_Nm3h >= c_rMaxPrimaryLeakage_Nm3h THEN
    dwWarningWord2 := dwWarningWord2 OR 16#00000400; (* Bit 10: Primary Seal Leakage High Warning *)
END_IF;

(* === 9. COMPREHENSIVE SIL-3 SAFETY ALARM TREE & TRIP LATCHING === *)
(* 9.1 Evaluation of Critical Process Trips into dwAlarmWord1 *)
IF NOT bEStopTripped THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00000001; (* Bit 0: Emergency Stop Tripped *)
END_IF;

IF rVibrationRadialDE_X_mms >= 18.0 OR rVibrationRadialDE_Y_mms >= 18.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00000040; (* Bit 6: DE Radial Vibration High-High Trip *)
ELSIF rVibrationRadialDE_X_mms >= 9.0 OR rVibrationRadialDE_Y_mms >= 9.0 THEN
    dwWarningWord1 := dwWarningWord1 OR 16#00000080; (* Bit 7: DE Radial Vibration Warning *)
END_IF;

IF rVibrationRadialNDE_X_mms >= 18.0 OR rVibrationRadialNDE_Y_mms >= 18.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00000080; (* Bit 7: NDE Radial Vibration High-High Trip *)
ELSIF rVibrationRadialNDE_X_mms >= 9.0 OR rVibrationRadialNDE_Y_mms >= 9.0 THEN
    dwWarningWord1 := dwWarningWord1 OR 16#00000100; (* Bit 8: NDE Radial Vibration Warning *)
END_IF;

IF ABS(rShaftAxialThrust_um) >= 120.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00000100; (* Bit 8: Axial Thrust High-High Trip *)
ELSIF ABS(rShaftAxialThrust_um) >= 75.0 THEN
    dwWarningWord1 := dwWarningWord1 OR 16#00000200; (* Bit 9: Axial Thrust Warning *)
END_IF;

IF rDischTemp_Voted_K >= 430.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00004000; (* Bit 14: Discharge Gas Temp High-High Trip *)
ELSIF rDischTemp_Voted_K >= 405.0 THEN
    dwWarningWord1 := dwWarningWord1 OR 16#00000040; (* Bit 6: Discharge Gas Temp Warning *)
END_IF;

IF rAcousticPulsationRMS_mbar >= 4500.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00002000; (* Bit 13: Pipeline Acoustic Pulsation High-High Trip *)
ELSIF rAcousticPulsationRMS_mbar >= 2200.0 THEN
    dwWarningWord1 := dwWarningWord1 OR 16#00000010; (* Bit 4: Acoustic Pulsation High Warning *)
END_IF;

(* 9.2 Evaluation of Operating Boundary Trips into dwAlarmWord2 *)
IF rDischPress_Voted_bar >= c_rMaxDischargePressure_bar THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#00000001; (* Bit 0: Discharge Pressure MAOP High-High *)
END_IF;

IF rSuctPress_Voted_bar <= c_rMinSuctionPressure_bar THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#00000002; (* Bit 1: Suction Pressure Low-Low *)
END_IF;

IF rDriverPower_kW >= 26500.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#00000004; (* Bit 2: Drive Motor Overpower Trip *)
END_IF;

IF rGasPurityH2_pct <= 95.0 AND rGasPurityH2_pct > 0.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#00000010; (* Bit 4: Gas Purity Contamination Trip *)
END_IF;

IF ABS(rGasMolecularWeight_gmol - c_rNominalMolecularWeight_H2) >= c_rMaxAllowableMW_Deviation THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#00000020; (* Bit 5: Gas Molecular Weight Shift Trip *)
END_IF;

IF bEmergencyDepressurizeReq THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#00000200; (* Bit 9: Pipeline ESD Depressurization Request *)
END_IF;

(* 9.3 Deep Surge Cycle Accumulator within 60s Sliding Window *)
IF (rDistanceToSCL_pct < -8.0) AND (rFlowDP_Voted_mbar < 10.0) AND NOT bSurgeCycleLatched THEN
    bSurgeCycleLatched := TRUE;
    uiSurgeCycleCount := uiSurgeCycleCount + 1;
    dwWarningWord1 := dwWarningWord1 OR 16#00000020; (* Bit 5: Single Surge Cycle Detected *)
ELSIF rDistanceToSCL_pct > 5.0 THEN
    bSurgeCycleLatched := FALSE;
END_IF;

tSurgeCycleTimer(IN := (uiSurgeCycleCount > 0), PT := T#60S);
IF tSurgeCycleTimer.Q THEN
    tSurgeCycleTimer(IN := FALSE);
    uiSurgeCycleCount := 0; (* Reset window counter if 60s expires without lock *)
END_IF;

IF uiSurgeCycleCount >= 3 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#00000020; (* Bit 5: Deep Surge Cycle Lockout Trip *)
END_IF;

(* 9.4 Master Trip Determination *)
IF (dwAlarmWord1 <> 16#00000000) OR (dwAlarmWord2 <> 16#00000000) OR (dwAlarmWord3 <> 16#00000000) THEN
    bCompressorTrip := TRUE;
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    iState := 99; (* Force transition to Emergency Shutdown *)
ELSE
    bCompressorTrip := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Alarm Reset Logic *)
IF bResetAlarms AND NOT bCompressorTrip THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := 16#00000000;
    dwAlarmWord2 := 16#00000000;
    dwAlarmWord3 := 16#00000000;
    uiSurgeCycleCount := 0;
END_IF;

(* System Ready Permissive Evaluation *)
IF (dwAlarmWord1 = 16#00000000) AND (dwAlarmWord2 = 16#00000000) AND (dwAlarmWord3 = 16#00000000) AND
   bEStopTripped AND (rSuctPress_Voted_bar >= 40.0) AND bSealVacuumHealthy THEN
    bSystemReady := TRUE;
ELSE
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* === 10. MULTI-STAGE OPERATIONAL FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) === *)
CASE iState OF
    0: (* FSM_IDLE_STANDBY: Plant Safe Depressurized Standby *)
        bAntiSurgeValveFullOpen  := TRUE;
        rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct:= 100.0;
        rSpeedRefActual_rpm      := 0.0;
        rBlowdownValveCmd_pct    := 0.0;
        bMPCActive               := FALSE;
        bAcousticDampingEngaged  := FALSE;
        rASV_PID_Integral        := 100.0;

        IF bEnableSystem AND bSystemReady AND bAutoModeRequest THEN
            iState := 10; (* Transition to Inert Purge *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* FSM_N2_INERT_PURGE: Nitrogen Displacement Purge *)
        bAntiSurgeValveFullOpen  := TRUE;
        rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct:= 100.0;
        rSpeedRefActual_rpm      := 0.0;

        tPurgeTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#30S);
        IF tPurgeTimer.Q THEN
            tPurgeTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 20; (* Transition to H2 Pressurization & Vacuum Extraction *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* FSM_H2_PRESSURIZATION_AND_SEAL_VACUUM: Introduce H2, Engage Vacuum Loop *)
        bAntiSurgeValveFullOpen  := TRUE;
        rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct:= 100.0;
        rSpeedRefActual_rpm      := 0.0;

        (* Engage vacuum extraction control valve *)
        rVacValveActual_pct := rVacExtractionValveRaw_pct;

        IF bSealVacuumHealthy AND (rPrimarySealDP_bar >= c_rMinPrimarySealDP_bar) AND (rSuctPress_Voted_bar >= 45.0) THEN
            iState := 30; (* Transition to Magnetic Bearing Permissive *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* FSM_BEARING_LEVITATION_AND_LUBE_PERMISSIVE: Active Magnetic Bearing Verification *)
        bAntiSurgeValveFullOpen  := TRUE;
        rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct:= 100.0;
        rSpeedRefActual_rpm      := 0.0;

        IF ABS(rShaftAxialThrust_um) < 25.0 AND (rBearingMetalTempMax_K < 340.0) THEN
            iState := 40; (* Transition to Slow Roll Warmup *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* FSM_SLOW_ROLL_WARMUP: Rotor Unbowing at 1,200 rpm *)
        bAntiSurgeValveFullOpen  := TRUE;
        rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct:= 100.0;
        rSpeedRefActual_rpm      := 1200.0;

        tWarmupTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#45S);
        IF tWarmupTimer.Q AND (rVibrationRadialDE_X_mms < 4.0) THEN
            tWarmupTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 50; (* Transition to Critical Speed Acceleration *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* FSM_ACCELERATION_THROUGH_CRITICALS: Rapid Ramp Through 3,500 - 8,200 rpm *)
        bAntiSurgeValveFullOpen  := TRUE;
        rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct:= 100.0;
        rSpeedRefActual_rpm      := 12500.0; (* Accelerate directly to minimum governor speed *)

        IF rShaftSpeed_Voted_rpm >= 12400.0 THEN
            iState := 60; (* Transition to Pipeline Packing & Recycle *)
        END_IF;

    60: (* FSM_PIPELINE_PACKING_AND_RECYCLE: Modulate ASV to Build Pressure *)
        rSpeedRefActual_rpm := 12500.0;
        (* Slowly close ASV from 100% towards 35% *)
        IF rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct > 35.0 THEN
            rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct := rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct - (1.5 * rDt);
        END_IF;

        IF (rDischPress_Voted_bar >= (rDischargeHeaderPress_bar - 2.0)) AND (rSurgeMargin_pct >= 18.0) THEN
            iState := 70; (* Transition to Online Closed-Loop MPC Mode *)
        END_IF;

    70: (* FSM_ONLINE_MPC_ANTISURGE_AND_ACOUSTIC_DAMPING: Full Pipeline Transmission *)
        bAntiSurgeValveFullOpen := FALSE;
        rSpeedRefActual_rpm := 18500.0; (* Nominal 100-bar pipeline cruise speed *)

        (* Anti-surge actuator command from MPC or Fallback PID *)
        IF bMPCActive THEN
            rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct := rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct + arrDeltaU_Opt[1];
        ELSE
            rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct := rASV_PID_Output;
        END_IF;

        (* Inject open-loop rate kick and acoustic pulsation micro-dither *)
        rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct := rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct + rValveKickBias_pct + rAcousticDitherModulation;

        (* Check for surge boundary violation *)
        IF rDistanceToSCL_pct < -4.0 THEN
            iState := 80; (* Transition to Fast Surge Decoupling Kick *)
        ELSIF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
            iState := 90; (* Normal Stop Requested *)
        END_IF;

    80: (* FSM_RAPID_SURGE_DECOUPLING_AND_KICK: Emergency Aerodynamic Recovery *)
        (* Force ASV opening at maximum rate *)
        rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct := rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct + (c_rASV_MaxOpenRate_pct_s * rDt);
        rSpeedRefActual_rpm := MAX(12500.0, rSpeedRefActual_rpm - (500.0 * rDt));

        IF rSurgeMargin_pct >= 20.0 THEN
            iState := 70; (* Recovered, return to online MPC *)
        END_IF;

    90: (* FSM_CONTROLLED_DECELERATION_COOLDOWN: Controlled Pipeline Unloading *)
        bAntiSurgeValveFullOpen := FALSE;
        (* Ramp open ASV to 100% *)
        IF rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct < 100.0 THEN
            rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct := rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct + (8.0 * rDt);
        END_IF;

        (* Decelerate speed *)
        IF rSpeedRefActual_rpm > 1200.0 THEN
            rSpeedRefActual_rpm := rSpeedRefActual_rpm - (150.0 * rDt);
        ELSE
            rSpeedRefActual_rpm := 0.0;
            iState := 0; (* Returned to safe idle *)
        END_IF;

    99: (* FSM_EMERGENCY_SHUTDOWN_TRIP_DEPRESSURIZE: SIL-3 Trip & Flare Isolation *)
        bAntiSurgeValveFullOpen   := TRUE;
        rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct := 100.0;
        rSpeedRefActual_rpm       := 0.0;
        bMPCActive                := FALSE;
        bAcousticDampingEngaged   := FALSE;

        IF bEmergencyDepressurizeReq THEN
            rBlowdownValveCmd_pct := 100.0; (* Dump high-pressure H2 to flare header *)
        ELSE
            rBlowdownValveCmd_pct := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        tDepressurizeTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#60S);
        IF tDepressurizeTimer.Q AND bResetAlarms AND NOT bCompressorTrip AND bEStopTripped THEN
            tDepressurizeTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 0; (* Reset to Idle after depressurization cooldown *)
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

(* === 11. ACTUATOR COMMAND CONDITIONING & ASYMMETRIC RATE LIMITING === *)
(* Clamp Anti-Surge Valve position between 0.0% and 100.0% *)
rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct := MAX(0.0, MIN(100.0, rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct));
rAntiSurgeValveCmd_pct    := rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct;

(* Clamp Speed Reference between 0 and 24,000 rpm *)
rSpeedRefActual_rpm       := MAX(0.0, MIN(24000.0, rSpeedRefActual_rpm));
rSpeedReference_rpm       := rSpeedRefActual_rpm;

(* Clamp Vacuum Extraction Valve Command *)
rVacuumExtractionValveCmd_pct := MAX(0.0, MIN(100.0, rVacExtractionValveRaw_pct));

(* === 12. TELEMETRY, ANALYTICS & DIAGNOSTIC UPDATES === *)
(* Update Sequence Status *)
wCompressorState := INT_TO_WORD(iState);

(* Real-Time Polytropic Efficiency Evaluation *)
IF rSuctTemp_Voted_K > 10.0 AND rDischTemp_Voted_K > rSuctTemp_Voted_K AND rCompressionRatio > 1.05 THEN
    rPolytropicEfficiency_pct := (((rGamma - 1.0) / rGamma) * LN(rCompressionRatio)) /
                                 LN(rDischTemp_Voted_K / rSuctTemp_Voted_K) * 100.0;
    rPolytropicEfficiency_pct := MAX(40.0, MIN(92.0, rPolytropicEfficiency_pct));
ELSE
    rPolytropicEfficiency_pct := 82.5;
END_IF;

(* Store previous cycle variables for next scan derivative evaluation *)
rPrevSurgeMargin_pct := rSurgeMargin_pct;
rPrevShaftSpeed_rpm  := rShaftSpeed_Voted_rpm;
rPrevSuctPress_bar   := rSuctPress_Voted_bar;
rPrevDischPress_bar  := rDischPress_Voted_bar;
rPrevFlowDP_mbar     := rFlowDP_Voted_mbar;
rPrevASVPosition_pct := rAntiSurgeValveActual_pct;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
